title: Limitation of Actions Act 1958
why: Limitation periods: s 5 (contract and tort, six years), Part IIA personal injury actions (s 27D: three years from discoverability, twelve years long-stop; s 27E discoverability; s 27F knowledge; s 27I minors and s 27J people with a disability; s 27K extension by the court), Division 5 of Part IIA (no limitation period for child abuse actions, and setting aside earlier settlements, s 27QE), Part II disability and fraud extensions.

text.conversion: The Word file was converted to UTF-8 plain text by Legalese Commons (vic_convert.py: stdlib zipfile and ElementTree over word/document.xml). The table of provisions, running heads and footers are dropped; the cover is kept as the file prints it (twice). Each provision starts on its own line with its number; paragraphs are indented two spaces a level; the register's marginal history notes are kept as "[Side note: ...]" lines before the provision they annotate; tables are "| a | b |" rows; Word equations are linearised in place. The endnotes (amendment history) are kept. Nothing else is changed.
known_conversion_artefacts: the cover (version number, title, number, version date) appears twice at the head, as in the Word file
the "Note" and "Example" labels stand on their own line, unindented, before their text
multi-line formulas set as indented paragraphs keep their brackets but lose their alignment
